reason: Does not assemble. Applied to a clean copy of HEAD (git archive) and built: the shipping build (make) fails at src/game.6502:3411, ASSERT HI(um_next - 1) == HI(um_next + 8): the +9 slide puts um_next's 9-byte table across a page, which the um_next-1,X/Y reads must not do (the candidate's relies_on names this ASSERT but did not check it still holds). The DEBUG_FULLREDRAW oracle build fails as well, and on more: the same um_next ASSERT, 'layer 1's code overruns the free block by 5 bytes' (that build has only 4 bytes free before &3400, SKIP at &33FC), and kindcache.6502:43's ASSERT, so the passlock/worldrun control twin could not even be built. The logic itself (the inlined JSR, C and A/X on both returns, the hostile path via mmr_hostile_g3a, no stack tricks in the callees) checks out, but the room and the alignment do not.
